meta.name: exec-briefing-memo
meta.description: Decision needed + recommendation + evidence + tradeoffs, 把复杂材料压成可拍板的一页

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂材料压成可拍板的一页简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速从长篇材料提炼决策要点
copy.tagline_en: Condense complex materials into a one-page decision memo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly distill key decision points from lengthy materials

howto.what: Claude 会将你提供的复杂材料（如会议记录、调研报告）压缩成一页高管决策备忘录，包含决策问题、推荐方案、关键证据、权衡对比和下一步行动。
howto.when: 当你需要就某个战略问题做出决策，并提供了相关背景材料（如销售反馈、产品数据、投资备忘）时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份是否进入 Enterprise Plan 的决策简报。
say.note: Claude 会输出一页 memo，包含推荐动作和权衡。

say.text: 根据这些销售反馈和财务数据，生成高管简报。
say.note: Claude 会提炼关键事实和风险。

howto.what_en: Claude compresses complex materials (e.g., meeting notes, research) into a one-page executive briefing memo with decision needed, recommendation, key evidence, tradeoffs, and next actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a decision on a strategic issue and provide relevant background materials (e.g., sales feedback, product data, investment memos).

say_en.text: Create an executive briefing memo on whether to enter the Enterprise Plan.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a one-page memo with recommendation and tradeoffs.

say_en.text: Generate a briefing memo from these sales feedback and financial data.
say_en.note: Claude extracts key facts and risks.
